items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Head
items.detail: Use Enforcer perk with shotgun or aim at head in V.A.T.S.; West Tek Research Center has dense spawns.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any deep water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is safe and easy.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and enter the Daily Operation instance from World Activity.

items.title: Cripple enemy limbs
items.detail: Aim at limbs with rifle using V.A.T.S.; Morgantown Airport has Scorched enemies.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Energy weapons are effective; RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns.

items.title: Eat a Raw Fish
items.detail: Catch fish at Fisherman's Rest and eat raw from Pip-Boy before cooking.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Look for masked cultists near cabins and fairgrounds; listen for child's laughter.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Build basic wood or concrete floors in build menu and scrap them; minimal resources needed.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Complete at any water source; Fisherman's Rest is recommended.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find the gray cloudy area on map, fast travel inside, locate the red circle hotspot, and clear the encounter.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at Cooking Station; small fish yield 1, medium yield 2, large yield 5, Axolotl yield 25.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Any robot type counts; RobCo Research Center is reliable.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume pre-war foods like BlamCo Mac and Cheese or collect from Weenie Wagon, Popcorn Machine, or Cookie Jar.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Solomon's Pond has reliable spawns; target the eyes as weak spot.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Kill masked cultists within an active Infestation hotspot.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event and stay in Vertibot area for Phantom to spawn.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: A community contest to build C.A.M.P.s or Shelters inspired by classic slasher movies with prizes including Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: A seasonal spooky event with Pint-Sized Phantom encounters at various locations throughout Appalachia.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation rates apply during this weekend event.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: A seasonal event featuring spooky-themed Scorched enemies with special rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Players earn double experience points during this weekend event.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chances to catch seasonal fish during this fishing-focused weekend event.
